facts.fact: A 2024 study found that 82% of advertisers reported using dynamic creative optimization (DCO) as part of their digital advertising strategy.
facts.quote: A 2024 study found that 82% of advertisers reported using DCO as part of their digital advertising strategy

facts.fact: The same 2024 study found that a third of advertisers planned to increase their use of DCO.
facts.quote: and a third planned to increase their use.

facts.fact: The page states that the share of advertisers using DCO was 60% in 2015, citing an IAB/Celtra/Digiday document.
DCO has existed as a marketing technology since the early 2010s, according to the page.
facts.quote: Although DCO has existed as a [marketing technology](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/what-is-martech) since the early 2010s

facts.fact: Citing studies, the page says personalized campaigns can help increase marketing ROI by 10-30% (third-party claim).
facts.quote: Studies show that personalized campaigns can help increase marketing ROI by [10-30%]

facts.fact: DCO can automate the creation of hundreds of ad variations, each customized to a customer's interests and behaviours.
facts.quote: automate the creation of hundreds of ad variations, each customized to a customer’s interests and behaviours

facts.fact: According to the page, a DCO platform assembles and populates the creative template for each ad impression within a fraction of a second.
facts.quote: all within a fraction of a second

facts.fact: According to a recent Yahoo! Survey cited by StackAdapt, 56% of marketers said that running DCO across multiple channels or formats was an important part of their strategy.
facts.quote: According to [a recent Yahoo! Survey](https://www.advanced-television.com/2024/03/07/study-dynamic-creative-optimisation-spend-surge-predicted/), 56% of marketers said that running DCO across multiple channels or formats was an important part of their strategy.

facts.fact: DCO has traditionally used 3rd-party cookies to track user behaviour and personalize ads, and is evolving to rely more on 1st-party data gathered through explicit consent.
facts.quote: DCO has traditionally used 3rd-party cookies to track user behaviour and personalize ads. However, due to rising privacy regulations and the ongoing phase-out of 3rd-party cookies

facts.fact: Programmatic refers to the automated buying and placement of digital ads, whereas DCO focuses on automatically assembling and personalizing ad content in real time based on user data, behaviour, and contextual signals.
facts.quote: Programmatic refers to the automated buying and placement of digital ads. DCO, on the other hand, focuses on the creative side

facts.fact: DCO has so far been mostly limited to performance-driven channels such as native and display advertising, while premium formats like programmatic video and connected TV were previously too costly for most brands and agencies to personalize at scale.
facts.quote: So far, DCO has mostly been limited to performance-driven channels like native and display advertising. channels that were previously too costly for most brands and agencies to personalize and optimize at scale.
